title: FULLSCREEN GATE AND GO FULLSCREEN BUTTONS
why: His order of 10-27: the game plays fullscreen, or the player holds the mouse 5 s to play windowed and accept glitches. A pause screen pops at the start and every time fullscreen is left, in 1P and in each 2P window; it says esc leaves fullscreen so pause with tab, and f11 works any time on chrome. Go fullscreen buttons on the pause menu and on the raid screen, shown only while windowed. His own exception to no new features until 11/1.
now: Play fullscreen or hold 5 s for windowed; the gate returns whenever fullscreen is left.
